record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: Is the pi_1-sensitive Hofer-Zehnder capacity of the disk cotangent bundle D*Q finite for every closed manifold Q that is not a K(pi,1)?

evidence.quote: One could also conjecture that the π1-sensitive Hofer-Zehnder capacity

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $Q$ be a closed (compact, without boundary) smooth manifold, and let $T^*Q$ denote its cotangent bundle equipped with the canonical symplectic form $\omega = d\lambda$, where $\lambda$ is the Liouville $1$-form. Fix a Riemannian metric on $Q$, and let
$$D^*Q = \{(q,p) \in T^*Q : \|p\|_q \le 1\}$$
denote the associated unit disk cotangent bundle, a compact symplectic manifold with boundary.

For a symplectic manifold $(M,\omega)$ and a subset $A \subseteq M$, the $\pi_1$-sensitive Hofer–Zehnder capacity $c_{HZ}^\circ(A,M)$ is defined as the supremum of $\max H - \min H$ over all smooth compactly supported Hamiltonians $H : M \to \mathbb{R}$ with support in $A$ such that the Hamiltonian flow of $H$ has no non-constant contractible (in $M$) periodic orbit of period $\le 1$. Equivalently, one allows admissible Hamiltonians whose fast periodic orbits are required to be contractible loops in $M$.

Recall that a topological space $X$ is called a $K(\pi,1)$ (aspherical) if its higher homotopy groups $\pi_k(X)$ vanish for all $k \ge 2$.

Question: Is it true that for every closed smooth manifold $Q$ which is not a $K(\pi,1)$, the $\pi_1$-sensitive Hofer–Zehnder capacity $c_{HZ}^\circ(D^*Q, T^*Q)$ is finite?
artifact.status_search_result: Finiteness of the (π₁-sensitive) Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles has been established in many special cases — for instance when the base admits a circle action with non-contractible orbits, when the Hurewicz map π₂(Q) → H₂(Q,ℤ) is non-zero, when Q is rationally inessential, and for projective spaces and constant curvature surfaces. However, the general conjecture covering all closed non-aspherical manifolds Q has not been settled in the literature found, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of unit disk cotangent bundles and the loop product
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness result for the Hofer-Zehnder capacity of certain unit disk cotangent bundles via pair-of-pants product on Floer homology.
status_evidence.claim: Finiteness is proved in special cases but not in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of disc tangent bundles of projective spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Computes Hofer–Zehnder capacity for projective spaces; shows π1-sensitive and relative HZ capacities agree in these cases.
status_evidence.claim: Special-case computations support the conjecture but do not resolve it.

status_evidence.title: Hofer–Zehnder capacity of magnetic disc tangent bundles over constant curvature surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Computes HZ capacity for magnetic disc bundles over constant curvature surfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Continued partial progress, general case not addressed.
